question.text: Water rises in a capillary tube to a height of <math><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. In another capillary where the radius is one-third of it, how high will the water rise (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>cm</mi></math>)?
